question: Which categories are most profitable?
interpretation: Profit means gross margin: sale_price minus products.cost. The dataset has no shipping, marketing or overhead costs, so state that this is not net profit. Show both total margin and margin percentage, because they usually rank differently.
sql:
SELECT p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(i.sale_price - p.cost), 2) AS gross_margin,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(i.sale_price - p.cost), SUM(i.sale_price)), 3) AS margin_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = i.product_id
WHERE i.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
report_guidance: Table ranked by total margin, with margin percentage alongside. Call out categories that are big but thin, and small but rich.
